newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares post gains on short-covering.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares post gains on short-covering.

text.p: Share prices on the Delhi Stock Exchange closed higher in hectic trade on Thursday as speculators made purchases to cover short positions ahead of the end of settlement, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index closed 5.61 points higher at 724.53. Friday will be the last day of the current settlement period.

"It seems that the operators were short in their positions in highly active stocks like Reliance Industries and State Bank of India and were forced to cover their positions ahead of tomorrow's settlement, which boosted the market," said Suresh Agarwal of brokers Jai Mata Securities.
Reliance Industries quoted 6.50 rupees higher at 268.25.
State Bank of India gained 6.25 rupees to 268.25.
ACC was up 30 rupees, or 2.5 percent, at 1,280.
